name: Gog
title: The Prince of Rosh
summary: Gog is a mysterious figure primarily mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecies (chapters 38–39) as a powerful ruler from the land of Magog. He is portrayed as a future enemy who will lead a massive coalition of nations against Israel in the last days, but who will be completely crushed by God. In Revelation, Gog and Magog are mentioned as symbols of the evil nations that gather for the final battle against God's people.

keyEvents.title: God's Word Against Gog
keyEvents.description: The Lord gives the prophet Ezekiel a word directed at Gog from Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and declares that God Himself will turn against him.

keyEvents.title: Gog's Army Assembly
keyEvents.description: Gog is to assemble an enormous coalition of nations, including Persia, Cush, and Put, and march up against the land of Israel with a mighty army force.

keyEvents.title: Gog's Evil Plan
keyEvents.description: Gog plans to attack peaceful, restored Israel in order to plunder and loot, but God has foreseen this and uses it in His plan.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on Gog
keyEvents.description: The Lord unleashes His wrath against Gog through earthquakes, plague, blood rain, hail, fire, and sulfur, and shows His holiness to all nations.

keyEvents.title: Gog's Complete Defeat
keyEvents.description: Gog's army is completely destroyed on the mountains of Israel. It takes seven months to bury the dead and seven years to burn their weapons.

keyEvents.title: Gog and Magog in the End Times
keyEvents.description: In Revelation, Gog and Magog are mentioned as symbols for the nations that Satan gathers for the final battle against God's people after the thousand-year reign, but they are consumed by fire from heaven.
